unlisted_practices: Using an automated in vivo task-based image quality metric (detectability index with an added frequency term in the internal noise) to reflect radiologist performance across conventional and deep learning CT reconstructions

screen.reason: The study tests an automated quality assurance safeguard/metric (an adjusted detectability index formalism) designed to monitor and reflect real-world clinical radiologist performance when deploying non-linear deep learning image reconstruction algorithms.

primary.practice: task-based image quality metric calibration for deep learning reconstruction
